implementation: Implementation name - Microsoft Windows 10 November 2015 Update; Microsoft Surface Book, Surface Pro 4, Surface Pro 3, Surface 3, Surface Pro 2, and Surface Pro w/ Windows 10 November 2015 Update; Windows 10 Mobile for Microsoft Lumia 950 and Microsoft Lumia 635; Windows 10 for Microsoft Surface Hub 84” and Surface Hub 55” BitLocker® Cryptographic Implementations
description: The Microsoft Windows BitLocker® algorithm implementation provides AES CCM support to the Windows Boot Manager and BitLocker® cryptographic modules.
